hero.headline: Music royalties operating system for an autonomous future.
hero.subhead: Debaser helps labels, publishers and catalogue owners ingest statements, understand contracts, detect missing income, and explain every royalty payment.

problem.headline: Royalty operations are still held together by spreadsheets, PDFs and hope.

items.title: Statements arrive in incompatible formats.
items.description: CSV from one DSP. PDF from another. A portal export that doesn't match the previous quarter. No two sources speak the same language.

items.title: Contracts live outside the systems that calculate payments.
items.description: Rates, splits, territories and deductions exist in PDFs no system has ever read. Every calculation is manual, and manual is wrong.

items.title: Metadata breaks before money moves.
items.description: Missing ISRCs. Misspelled artist names. Recordings that exist under three different titles. Income that cannot find its owner.

items.title: Artists ask questions finance teams cannot answer quickly.
items.description: "Why did my income drop 30%?" Answering that question takes days. The audit trail is a spreadsheet buried in email.

items.title: Missing income is discovered late, if ever.
items.description: Underpayments go unchallenged. CMO collections are never chased. Gap analysis requires expertise most teams do not have time for.

productFlow.headline: From statement to explanation.
productFlow.subhead: Debaser turns messy royalty inputs into a source-backed operational workflow your team can trust.

steps.label: Ingest
steps.description: Pull in statements, contracts and catalogue data from any source — CSV, PDF, portal export or API feed.

steps.label: Match
steps.description: Link income to ISRCs, ISWCs, works, recordings, writers, labels and ownership splits across your catalogue.
steps.detail: ISRC · ISWC · Work codes · Party IDs

steps.label: Analyse
steps.description: Surface anomalies, variance from expected income, contract exceptions and metadata conflicts automatically.

steps.label: Explain
steps.description: Generate source-backed answers to any payment question — with references to rows, clauses and metadata.
steps.detail: Source rows · Contract clauses · Audit trail

steps.label: Resolve
steps.description: Turn every issue into a prioritised action. Prepare claims, approve payments, and close the loop before statements go out.

agents.headline: Agents for the royalty work nobody wants to do manually.

items.name: Ingestion Agent
items.description: Maps messy CSVs, PDFs, API exports and portal data into a standard royalty schema — regardless of source format.

items.name: Contract Agent
items.description: Extracts splits, rates, territories, deductions, recoupment clauses and exceptions directly from contract documents.

items.name: Matching Agent
items.description: Links income to ISRCs, ISWCs, artists, writers, labels, works and recordings across your rights catalogue.

items.name: Exception Agent
items.description: Finds duplicates, missing splits, unexplained income drops, expired contracts and unmatched source rows.

items.name: Audit Agent
items.description: Compares expected income against received statements, surfaces gaps and prepares claim evidence by territory.

items.name: Ops Agent
items.description: Turns every royalty run into a prioritised action list your team can work through before a single payment goes out.

useCases.headline: Built for the teams behind the catalogue.

items.headline: Reconcile before statements go out.
items.description: Ingest distributor and DSP income, match it to your catalogue, and catch every discrepancy before artists and writers are paid.

items.headline: Contracts and income in one place.
items.description: Connect works, writers, splits and income with contract-backed clarity. Know what every co-pub agreement should be generating.

items.headline: Monitor every acquisition.
items.description: Track performance, anomalies and missing income across acquired rights. Surface underperformers and unrecovered income at scale.

items.headline: Audit income with evidence.
items.description: Challenge bad statements with source-level evidence. Know exactly which DSPs, territories and releases are underperforming.

items.headline: Compare usage, claims and collections.
items.description: Map usage signals to collection statements across territories. Surface gaps between what was claimed and what was received.

missingMoney.headline: Find the money that never made it to the statement.
missingMoney.subhead: Debaser compares catalogue expectations, usage signals and royalty statements to surface likely underpayments, unmatched income and collection gaps.

explainability.headline: Every number should be able to defend itself.
explainability.body1: Ask why a royalty amount changed and Debaser traces the answer back to source rows, catalogue metadata and contract terms.
explainability.body2: Not a summary. Not a hallucination. A structured answer with direct references to the evidence — so your team can verify, audit and act.
explainability.chatUserMessage: Why did this artist earn less this quarter?
explainability.chatAiResponse: Spotify UK income dropped 31% versus Q1. Two tracks were unmatched due to missing ISRCs, accounting for an estimated £3,100 in unattributed income. Additionally, the producer deduction was applied before the recoupment threshold was reached, which is inconsistent with clause 4.2(b) of the recording agreement.

trust.headline: Built for sensitive music rights data.
trust.subhead: Royalty data is some of the most commercially sensitive information in the music industry. We treat it accordingly.

items.title: Role-based access
items.description: Control exactly who sees what — by catalogue, territory, deal type or run stage.

items.title: Audit trails
items.description: Every action is logged with timestamp and user. Every AI output is traceable to source data.

items.title: Source-backed AI
items.description: No output without evidence. Every insight references the row, document or clause it came from.

items.title: Human approval workflows
items.description: AI flags and investigates. Humans review and approve. No royalty run goes out without sign-off.

items.title: Private workspaces
items.description: Your data stays yours. Isolated tenancy, no cross-client data access by design.

items.title: Exportable evidence
items.description: Every claim, audit and discrepancy is exportable in formats your legal and finance teams can use.

items.title: Designed for compliance
items.description: Architecture and workflows designed for the governance standards expected by serious music companies.

items.title: Transparent outputs
items.description: Every recommendation includes the confidence level, the reasoning and the raw source it draws from.

vision.headline: The rights graph for the global music economy.
vision.body1: Royalty intelligence is the wedge. The long-term vision is a connected rights graph that understands songs, recordings, contracts, ownership, usage and payments — across every territory and revenue stream.
vision.body2: We are starting where the pain is deepest: the operational layer where statements arrive, income goes missing and teams are drowning in work that software should be doing.
vision.graphCaption: Songs → Recordings → Contracts → Income → Ownership → Usage

footer.tagline: The AI operating system for music royalties.
footer.principle: AI investigates. Humans approve. Deterministic engines calculate.
